AEW Dynamite Preview: Fallout from WrestleDream, IIja Dragonuv’s in-ring debut, World Tag Team Title Eliminator Match

Jerome Wilen
October 21, 2026
0

AEW Dynamite airs live tonight on TBS and HBO Max, from the Watsco Center on the campus of the University of Miami in Coral Gables, Florida, beginning at 8:00 pm ET.

At the time of this writing, Tony Khan is advertising the following for tonight’s show.

-AEW World Tag Team Championship Eliminator Match: Young Bucks (Matt Jackson and Nick Jackson) vs. Mark Davis and Jake Doyle

-AEW World Champion Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland vs. Kevin Knight and Kyle Fletcher

-TBS Championship No. 1 Contenders Match: Maya World vs. Queen Aminata

-Ilja Dragunov vs. “Speedball” Mike Bailey

    *Live coverage of tonight’s AEW Dynamite will begin at 8:00 pm ET*
